title: Stasis & Vellum
description: A surreal night scene shows a hooded woman with glowing blue tears and eyes, her hand outstretched toward a small glowing blue lobster in a puddle. A black wolf howls beside her while a large circular emblem filled with white skeletal lobsters and a central blue face dominates the rainy background above a crowd of people holding umbrellas.
prompt: A dark surreal fantasy scene at night in the rain, a hooded woman with glowing blue tears and bright blue eyes reaches toward a small luminous blue lobster standing in a puddle. A black wolf howls upward beside her. Behind them a large intricate circular emblem with skeletal white lobsters arranged in a mandala around a central blue woman's face glows against a dark wall. A crowd of people with umbrellas stands below. Moody atmospheric lighting, intricate linework, dark fantasy aesthetic.
